sentences.text: The Land Acquisition Collector took into consideration one-year average .

sale price as was prevalent in Mohal Daundhi prior to publication of notification under Section 4 of the Act and vide award No.9 dated 30.06.2008, awarded Rs.2,59,410/- as compensation per bigha for Dhani Abal category of land.
The petitioners preferred reference petition under Section 18 of the Act, seeking to enhance the compensation.

r Learned Reference Court took into consideration the fact that average cost of Dhani Abal category of land per bigha was actually assessed at Rs.2,97,607/- and not 2,59,410/- per bigha as awarded by the Land Acquisition Collector.

The nature of the acquired land was also Dhani Abal, accordingly,
market value of the land was assessed at Rs.2,97,607/-.
3. The case of the petitioners is that learned Reference Court committed error in not relying upon the sale deeds placed and proved on record by the petitioners as Ex.PW-1/A to PW-1/C.

The sale deeds Ex.PW-1/A to Ex.PW-1/C relied upon by the petitioners were executed on 30.09.2006,
16.06.2007 and 08.07.2008, respectively, whereas, notification under Section 4 of the Act was issued on 03.08.2006 and published in the Rajpatra on 16.09.2006.
.
The sale deeds having been executed after the date of issuance/publication of notification under Section 4 of the Act, were rightly not relied upon by learned Reference Court.

No illegality can be said to have been committed by learned Reference Court in not assessing the market value of the acquired land on the basis of sale deeds Ex.PW-1/A to Ex.PW-1/C.
4.

The next contention raised by learned counsel for the petitioners is that there is error in relief (c)
allowed by learned Reference Court.

Relief (c), as contained in para-24 of the impugned award, runs as under: -
"c) they shall be entitled to interest under Section 23 of the Act on market value assessed under Section 23(1) of the Act, the additional compensation worked out under Section 23(1A) of the Act besides solatium awarded under Section 23(2) of the Act at the rate of 9% per annum from....? for a period of one year and thereafter at the rate of 15% per annum till the date of payment/deposit of the compensation as assessed above."
There seems to be a typographical error in the above extracted para (c).
The date has not been mentioned in the above para.

In view of the facts and circumstances of the case as discussed in the impugned award, the petitioners are held entitled to interest in this part of relief from the date of .
award.
